text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I decide to wander around the
offices
and get to know my fellow
trainers a bit better.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
You must understand that songs are not
merely
words timed to music.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: There is meaning to both the lyrics and the music. While your voice is consistent...

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: My songs lack feeling. Is that it?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, look at the time. We'll
continue this
tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I'll think of a solution. Try to gain a
deeper
understanding of the lyrics in the
meantime.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: All right. See you tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I saw you there, but I had to wrap things
up with
my runner first.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm glad you're of the same opinion.
choice_data_list: It's only natural to prioritize th...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: So, what can I help you with?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...I don't see why not. Let's go.
choice_data_list: How about having a meal together?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't expecting to eat at a karaoke

establishment.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
But I think I understand why. You
brought me here because of my
conversation with Little
Cocon earlier,
correct?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Absolutely. While it's impossible for me
to run
like one of them...
choice_data_list: I think demonstrating it would be ...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I should be capable of singing. Of
course, I'll need
an objective observer to
judge my performance.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: I hope you don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Phew... How was I?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
That's kind,
but I feel I wasn't sustaining
the notes
long enough.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: It seems I still need practice.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
One should not rely solely on data when
coming
up with a solution to a problem.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
What Little Cocon requires in her singing
is more
emotion. Practicing is the best
way for her to
learn this.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Now then, one more try!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I believe I held my notes well
that time.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: So you say, but now I am the one whose singing lacks emotional depth.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Sigh... It's one thing to give instructions, but another to execute them well. I've still got a long ways to go.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Little Cocon is awkward when it comes
to her
feelings and has trouble
expressing herself.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
That's why I must learn to sing with my
heart and
serve as an example to her.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I need to show her that music has the
power to
invoke emotions in others.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Are you prepared? I expect you to
accompany me
until I can sing well
enough to do so.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As her gentle, yet powerful, voice rises
and falls, I
can tell from her song just
how much she cares
about her racers.
